parameter.name: intune_auth_resource
parameter.description: A boolean option that makes Entra ID sign-in authenticate against the Microsoft Intune resource instead of the Microsoft Intune Enrollment resource. This applies to the user lookup and to interactive sign-in through the password and MFA flow, which also joins the device to Entra ID when it is not joined yet. A device code sign-in started directly is not affected; when the password and MFA flow falls back to a device code, the resulting token also targets the Microsoft Intune resource. On an already joined device, the password-only console fast path still authenticates against Microsoft Graph when allow_console_password_only is enabled; this option does not retarget that fast path. It selects the resource if authentication continues into the interactive password and MFA flow. Use this when Conditional Access policies treat the two resources differently, including on hosts that are not enrolled in Intune. This option does not enroll the device in Intune or apply Intune policies; apply_policy controls both. When apply_policy is enabled, the Microsoft Intune resource is always used and this option has no effect.
parameter.conf_description: Authenticate Entra ID sign-in and device join against Microsoft Intune instead of Microsoft Intune Enrollment, without Intune enrollment.
